prompt: Two Dog objects that seem equal fail equals() check. Why?
choices: Dog does not override equals() — the default Object.equals() checks reference identity, not field values
name must be static to be comparable
new Dog() creates cached objects that are different
explanation: Without overriding equals(), Dog inherits Object.equals() which uses ==. a and b are different objects, so == is false. Fix: override equals() to compare name fields: return other instanceof Dog d && this.name.equals(d.name);
